title: Tracing oxygen-atom relocation from carbohydrates to renewable chemicals for redox-economic and waste-minimized syntheses
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00011H, Critical Review
Open Access

Saikat Dutta
This review introduces the oxygen-atom relocation as a strategy to design redox-economic, waste-minimized synthesis of renewable chemicals from carbohydrates. Redox economy index (REI) has been introduced as a new green metric to evaluate strategies.
